title: result.json delivery contract
description: Every case emits one result.json. The fields under output_contract come from case.json and are copied verbatim by name; the skill never renames a contract field.

output_contract.description: One key per field in case.json → output_contract, with the delivered value. A missing field is a contract violation, not a formatting choice.

status.description: success only when all six element groups are filled from materials, no conflict remains, and no unsupported number reached the prose.

status_reasons.description: Required for anything other than success. Values look like `required_element_group_empty: controls` or `material_conflicts: 2`.

sources.description: The material inventory actually read. Unreadable files are absent here and present in uncertainty.

change_log.description: What the run did, in order: collect, extract, build. Not a narrative of the paper.

files.description: Relative paths of the delivered artifacts inside the output dir.

consistency_rules: a conflict in gaps.json must appear as a material_conflict uncertainty entry
any status other than success must carry status_reasons
a parameter row whose source address points at a file absent from evidence.csv is a violation
an empty required element group forces partial, it does not force prose
